notes: The cell is the lesson's fenced block, copied byte for byte. It sets no rlimit.
S4.L4 cell 3 (in RUN-z3-cti-pair, configuration s4l4-cell3) also checks I2 at Init, its step and a search to 6 steps.

Recorded with the bench image built from bench/image/Dockerfile (a local build; the digest is its manifest list's, never pushed). Each configuration ran once, in a fresh container with the run's cells mounted read-only at /w; <sandbox>/work stands for the scratch copy of runs/RUN-z3-inductive/cells/.
Every verdict line is copied from the logs; values.configs.<config>.lines is parsed from those lines by label (slugged), and the other values are read from that parse, never typed.
Recorded for the W1 report's follow-up 1 (task_label: W1-followup-1). run@1's task field must match W<n>-S<nn> or W<n>-T<nn>, which that name does not, so the record leaves task out.
Z3's model values are not canonical: a witness is checked by its property, never matched by value.
